column1: # Every file in the bundled GStreamer runtime, and the upstream project it comes from.
# The bundled runtime tree is NOT in this repository (tools/Fetch-GStreamerRuntime.ps1
# unpacks it), so this file is what lets ThirdPartyLicenseTests check that every shipped
# binary is covered by a license text under licenses/third-party/ -- and it is what
# .github/workflows/release.yml compares the real publish directory against -- an exact
# match (missing AND extra), because a count floor cannot catch extra files.
# Generated from the runtime tree, not written by hand. Plugin-to-subproject attribution
# attribution comes from where each library is built in the GStreamer 1.28.4 tree.
# Columns (tab separated): Path (relative to runtimes/win-x64), Project.
